edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: game-ready square UV texture atlas, StarLancer Azan fighter (native model Houjian).
Edit target: the supplied original 256x256 houjian.png atlas.
Reconstruct this exact complete worn texture atlas in very high resolution, ideally 4096x4096. This is a precision texture restoration, not an image of a spacecraft. Keep the complete original square edge-to-edge composition, UV island positions, scale, orientation, shape, panel borders, window outlines, radiator ribs, fasteners, warning triangles, red arrow markings and yellow/black hazard strips exactly registered to the reference. No margin, no cropping, no rearrangement. All markings must stay within their original footprints. The model will use its original UVs.
Preserve the original dark silver-grey painted metal and its worn industrial character, chipped edges and restrained grime. Refine the existing panels into legible crisp seams and physical surface detail. Keep every small red triangle, yellow caution marking and red detail in its original location. Do not invent lettering or insignia. Preserve the exact outlines of the warm amber/brown cockpit glazing islands; fill their interiors with smooth dark amber glass, very restrained tonal variation, no scratches or noisy patterns on glass, no baked bright reflection. Preserve the visible metal borders around the glass.
Use flat diffuse/albedo illumination so the game can provide lighting and reflection. Keep seam depth readable, but avoid deep baked shadows, bevel highlights wider than the original borders, greasy contrast or embossed painted graphics. Preserve original hardware arrangement and repeated vent spacing. No new objects, no global recolour, no spaceship render, no labels, no watermark. Return only the complete square opaque texture atlas.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this newly reconstructed Azan spacecraft UV atlas. Make one restrained correction to this atlas: smooth the dark amber cockpit glass in the two panes at the left middle around image x35-270,y500-620, and the long pane and short pane around x535-910,y460-540. These four regions are cockpit glazing. Keep each pane's EXACT existing boundary, shape, thickness of metal frame, location, and orientation. Replace only the glass interior with smooth opaque dark amber-brown glazing, almost uniform colour, slight subtle tonal falloff only, no window reflections painted into the image, no square reflections, no patterns, no scratches, no crisscross structure. The game reflection will supply highlights. Do not expand the glazing or alter any metal border. Keep the amber metal strip beside the bottom radiator and surrounding paint untouched. All other pixels/composition/hardware/markings should remain as close as possible to the input. Preserve the full square UV atlas edge-to-edge and its layout exactly. Do not add outlines, new panes or shapes, move panels, crop, add a margin, or alter any markings. Output the complete corrected opaque square atlas at maximum available resolution.
